title: Tide-Pool Glimmer
intro_lines: Tide-Puck bristles at the water's edge, ears flat.
Bioluminescence pulses in the shallows — not plankton.

choices.label: Wade in quietly with a net

outcomes.text: You scoop a luminous juvenile Mythos — Tide-Puck chirps approval.
The net tears; the creature slips away, leaving a shard in the mesh.
A parent surfaces, shrieking — you retreat bleeding.
Iron sinks deep; the beast thrashes, lighting the reef red.
The shaft glances off chitin; the creature vanishes, mocking.
Tide-Puck bites your ankle — the harpoon misses, rope burns hands.
You map the spot; Tide-Puck guards it through the night.
Morning tide erases your markers; the pool is gone.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk tamed feral cats and kid goats for company during his four-year isolation on Juan Fernández, learning to read animal behaviour for survival (RMG).

title: Wounded Light
intro_lines: The juvenile lies in a tidal cave, flank gashed by coral.
Its light dims with each breath; Tide-Puck whines.

choices.label: Feed it fish and bind the wound

outcomes.text: The creature accepts food; its hum steadies, scanning you.
It eats but the wound festers; you earn a wary truce.
A shard in the meat cuts its throat — light dies in your hands.

choices.label: Bind it with rope and train obedience

outcomes.text: Rope holds; the Mythos submits, eyes burning with hate.
It screams — a sound like tearing kelp — parents answer.
Tide-Puck tears the knots; the juvenile flees into deep water.
You leave fresh fish at the entrance; tide carries it in.
Next dawn the cave is empty — only a single scale remains.

history_note: Coral cuts infect quickly in tropical heat, and reef hazards such as urchin spines lodge deep (NOAA).

title: Parent's Wrath
intro_lines: The adult Mythos circles the shallows.
Tide-Puck hides behind your legs; the surf crashes red.

choices.label: Stand ground with cutlass and torch

outcomes.text: Fire drives it back; the beast retreats, trailing blood.
It lunges through flame; claws rake your shoulder.
A wave knocks you down; the creature flees into deep.
You scramble up the beach; the beast cannot follow on land.
Your foot catches a root; the surf drags you back toward it.

choices.label: Toss your catch into the surf as

outcomes.text: The parent snatches the fish, hum softening; it dives away.
It takes the meat but screams — a warning, not thanks.
The offering enrages it further; a tail-strike shatters your ribs.

history_note: The Tromelin castaways kept one fire alive for fifteen years using wreck timber and the island's single shrub, knowing relighting was near-impossible in humidity (Archaeology Mag 2014).

title: Crystal Blight
intro_lines: UTC dark-binding crystals jut from the ridge.
Boars and monkeys convulse nearby, eyes milky.

choices.label: Shatter the crystal with iron tools

outcomes.text: The crystal screams as it breaks; maddened beasts collapse, freed.
Shards explode outward; you take crystalline shrapnel.
The shockwave summons a UTC patrol investigating the silence.
You map its frequency; Tide-Puck howls at a harmonic you hear too.
The hum enters your skull; visions of the Abyssal Sovereign rise.
A maddened boar charges while you're distracted; tusk gores leg.

choices.label: Lure the beasts away with burning tar

outcomes.text: Fire and smoke draw the creatures off; crystals remain intact.
Wind shifts; flames catch your clothes and the jungle canopy.

history_note: Feral pigs introduced by sailors root up ground and charge when cornered, their tusks causing deep leg wounds (SPREP).

title: Scout's Judgment
intro_lines: The crystal dust settles.
A Tideborn scout steps from the mist,
shell-armour clicking, trident lowered — watching you.

choices.label: Offer the shards and speak openly

outcomes.text: The scout accepts; marks your hand with bioluminescent ink.
They take the shards but warn: 'The Sovereign dreams of you.'
A hidden UTC sniper drops the scout; you flee into fog.
Rope binds them; their kin will come. You hold a hostage.
They dissolve into humming mist; only a scale remains in rope.
The scout's trident pierces your gut before you close.

choices.label: Drive them off with warning shots

outcomes.text: Powder flashes; the scout retreats, signalling the ridge.
The shot hits — the scout falls, light fading from their eyes.

history_note: Bartholomew Roberts' articles mandated quarrels be settled ashore by pistol then cutlass, first blood wins (Johnson 1724).

title: Sovereign's Dream
intro_lines: Sleep takes you.
The Abyssal Sovereign's eye opens in the deep,
bioluminescent tendrils brushing your mind.

choices.label: Follow the vision to the coordinates

outcomes.text: You wake with the route burned into memory; Tide-Puck nods.
The vision fractures; you recall only fragmented depths.
The Sovereign's gaze lingers; you wake screaming, ears bleeding.

choices.label: Ignore it as fever-dream and tend

outcomes.text: Dawn comes normal; the dream fades like tide-foam.
Tide-Puck refuses food all day, staring at the sea.

choices.label: Share the vision with Silas and the crew

outcomes.text: Silas orders extra watch; the crew murmurs of old legends.
Half the crew demands marooning you for 'cursed talk'.
A UTC deserter in your crew slips away that night.

history_note: Ada Blackjack nursed Lorne Knight through scurvy until he died, then barricaded his body against animals while teaching herself to hunt alone (NPS).

title: Humming Stores
intro_lines: The storage hut vibrates at night.
a chord that makes teeth ache and Tide-Puck's fur stand up.

outcomes.text: The humming stops; shards grow cold, safe to handle.
One shard cracks, releasing a puff of luminous gas.

choices.label: Arrange them in a circle per Tideborn

outcomes.text: The chord resolves into a tone that points due west.
Light bridges the shards — a beacon UTC ships can see.
The circle burns a permanent mark into the hut floor.

choices.label: Grind one shard into powder for study

outcomes.text: Powder hums in water — reveals hidden Tideborn script on maps.
Dust infiltrates your lungs; coughing fits for days.
The powder ignites spontaneously, burning the hut.

history_note: The Tromelin castaways stored water in salvaged lead basins, using a triton shell as ladle, preserving resources for fifteen years (INRAP).

title: Net-Caught Mythos
intro_lines: UTC longliners haul a thrashing Mythos.
The net tears; the creature drags buoys toward your reef.

choices.label: Cut it free with knife and rope

outcomes.text: The net falls away; the Mythos circles once, then dives deep.
A stray filament wraps your wrist; the beast drags you under.
UTC spotters fire; splinters rake the deck as you cut.

choices.label: Harpoon it and claim the carcass

outcomes.text: Iron finds heart; you tow a fortune in hide and crystal-bone.
The harpoon snaps; the beast thrashes, smashing your boat.
Tide-Puck leaps onto the creature — both vanish beneath waves.
They tow it off, tossing you a barrel of salt pork for silence.
They ignore you; the net cuts deep, the Mythos screams.
Their captain recognizes you — a boarding party deploys.

history_note: Pirates careened ships on sloping beaches at high tide, heeling over to scrape teredo worm and weed while defenceless (JMU thesis).

title: Archway Whisper
intro_lines: Bioluminescent arches span the sea-cave — Tideborn ruins.
Each step echoes with voices speaking in tidal rhythms.

choices.label: Press a relic shard into the central

outcomes.text: The arch flares; a holographic map of leviathan migration appears.
The shard shatters; the map is incomplete, fragmented.
The arch screams — a sonic blast shatters your eardrums.

choices.label: Trace the humming script with charcoal

outcomes.text: You copy a warning: 'The Sovereign wakes when crystals bleed.'
The script shifts under your hand — the rubbing is nonsense.

choices.label: Sleep beneath the arches to catch dreams

outcomes.text: Visions of the sunken city flood you — coordinates burn clear.
You wake clutching a living pearl; the arches dim.
Tideborn scouts find you; you're bound and taken inland.

history_note: Pedro Serrano used seaweed, shells, and wreck planks as fuel on Serrana Bank, diving for two stones to strike sparks with his knife (Frontiers 2019).

title: Leviathan Lullaby
intro_lines: The Abyssal Sovereign's song vibrates through the sand
a subsonic hymn that makes coconuts fall and Tide-Puck howl.

choices.label: Walk into the surf and listen until dawn

outcomes.text: The song resolves into words: a warning of UTC crystal fleets.
Hypothermia sets in; crew hauls you out blue-lipped.
A riptide pulls you out; Tide-Puck bites the rope to save you.

choices.label: Beat drums to drown the song and rally

outcomes.text: Rhythm breaks the trance; crew cheers, morale surges.
The drums enrage the Sovereign — a tentacle smashes the dock.

choices.label: Record the frequency in a water-filled

outcomes.text: The shell captures a perfect tone — a key to Tideborn locks.
Water boils in the shell; steam burns your fingers.
The tone shatters the shell — and your hearing for days.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk read the Bible aloud to keep his speech during four years alone, maintaining routine against despair (DNB).

title: Harness or Harpoon
intro_lines: An ancient Tideborn harness lies in the grotto.
shaped for a Mythos mount.
A harpoon rack sits beside it.

choices.label: Bind the harness and seek a wild Mythos

outcomes.text: A juvenile accepts the harness; you ride the reef currents.
The harness fits but the beast bucks — you cling, bruised.
The kelp-cord strangles the creature — it dies in your arms.
You strike a sub-adult; the reef runs red. Power surges in you.
The harpoon misses; the Sovereign's eye opens in the deep.
Tide-Puck intercepts the throw — the harpoon pins your foot.

choices.label: Leave both and seal the grotto

outcomes.text: The grotto vanishes; the choice waits for a worthier hand.
A tremor cracks the seal — the harness pulses, waiting still.

history_note: Bartholomew Roberts' articles awarded 800 dollars for a lost limb and mandated weapons kept clean, reflecting pirate pragmatism (Johnson 1724).

title: Low-Tide Arch Ritual
intro_lines: Tideborn arches hum as water drains.
Relic shards warm in your pocket.

choices.label: Step through the arch at low tide

outcomes.text: Shards ring; Tide-Puck finds a hidden cache of shells.
The arch collapses; shards cut your hands.
You map the ritual; Tideborn scout notices you.
Nothing happens; tide returns early.

history_note: Pedro Serrano survived eight years on a cay by catching rain in shells and eating raw shellfish.

title: Tideborn Scout's Test
intro_lines: A scout steps from the mangroves.
She watches Tide-Puck closely.

outcomes.text: She accepts; grants passage to a relic cache.
She refuses; shards are sacred, not trade.
She vanishes; later your camp is watched.
She follows and warns of a UTC patrol.

history_note: Tromelin castaways built coral walls against the trade wind after storms destroyed their camp.

title: Crystal-Bound Mythos
intro_lines: Dark crystals pulse in a flooded cave.
A small Mythos thrashes, bound.

outcomes.text: It breaks free and nuzzles Tide-Puck.
Crystal shatters; shards embed in your arm.
UTC-grade crystals; Tide-Puck whines in distress.
The Mythos bites; crystals crumble to dust.

history_note: UTC deploys dark-binding crystals that enrage the Abyssal Sovereign.

title: Freed Mythos Gratitude
intro_lines: The freed Mythos shadows your camp.
It leaves gifts at dawn.

outcomes.text: Both companions learn a new foraging trick.
They fight; the new Mythos bolts.
It calls once, then vanishes into surf.
It returns at night with a pearl.

history_note: Selkirk tamed kid goats for milk and company during four years alone.

title: Crystal Shipment Intercepted
intro_lines: UTC cutter approaches your cove.
Crystals rattle in its hold.

outcomes.text: Cutter flees; you seize crystal crates.
UTC marines land; you barely escape.
They sail on, unaware of you.
A scout marks your outpost on a chart.

history_note: Pirates used false flags and headland ambushes in narrow channels.

title: Leviathan Song at Night
intro_lines: A low hum vibrates the rocks.
Tide-Puck howls at the moon.

outcomes.text: The hum softens; a relic shard washes ashore.
The sea churns; your boat is smashed.
You rest; Tide-Puck guards the door.
Nightmares; you wake exhausted and shaken.

history_note: The Abyssal Sovereign broke both ships during the storm battle.

title: Sovereign's Gift
intro_lines: A vast shape surfaces at dawn.
It leaves something on the sand.

outcomes.text: A pearl the size of a fist; Tide-Puck bows.
The gift dissolves into salt and foam.
The leviathan accepts; calm seas follow.
It ignores you; a storm brews offshore.

history_note: Tromelin castaways kept one fire alive fifteen years with salvaged timber.

title: Relic Shard Resonance
intro_lines: Three shards hum in unison.
Tide-Puck spins in circles.

outcomes.text: A map of Tideborn arches appears in light.
The circle cracks; shards scatter.
Hum fades; nothing more happens.
One shard cracks and cuts your palm.

history_note: Blueprint lore: UTC dark-binding crystals enrage the Abyssal Sovereign and wild Mythos near them.

title: Tideborn Arch at Dusk
intro_lines: Fog thickens around a stone arch.
Footprints lead through and vanish.

outcomes.text: You find a Tideborn cache of herbs and shells.
The arch loops back; you are lost for hours.
Tideborn later reward your restraint.
A UTC scout finds your marks instead.

history_note: Serrano used shells as rain catchers and a fire hut on his cay.

title: Crystal-Bound Mythos II
intro_lines: Lightning reveals a second bound Mythos.
Crystals sing a sharp, cruel note.

outcomes.text: Together they shatter the crystals; it flees free.
Crystals explode; Tide-Puck is stunned.
UTC pays in gold and crystals.
They seize your camp supplies as thanks.

history_note: UTC privateers hunt Tideborn relics and deploy dark-binding crystals.

title: Mythos Companion's Dream
intro_lines: Tide-Puck sleeps and twitches.
It dreams of drowned arches.

outcomes.text: It settles; morning brings a foraging find.
It snaps awake and nips your hand.
It wakes calm and alert to danger.
It sleepwalks into the surf; you rescue it.

history_note: Companion animals reduce despair for castaways, as Selkirk's cats did.

title: The Puck's Nose
intro_lines: Tide-Puck freezes mid-step, nostrils flared.
A faint pulse hums beneath the sand — something old.
The pup digs, uncovering a shard of iridescent coral.

outcomes.text: The shard dissolves on its tongue; bioluminescence ripples through its fur. It sneezes a cloud of humming spores.
The pup chokes, retching bile laced with light. Its hide blisters where the shard touched.
Nothing happens. The shard passes whole. Tide-Puck looks at you with mild disappointment.
You wrestle the shard free, fingers numb from cold light. Tide-Puck whines, circling your legs.
The pup snaps — not at you, but at the air above the shard. A tendril of dark water lashes your hand.
You kick sand over the hum. Tide-Puck pads away, uninterested. The pulse fades.
The ground trembles. The buried shard screams — a sound like tearing kelp. Something answers from the deep.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk tamed feral cats to combat rats gnawing his feet, showing castaways form bonds with animals for survival and sanity.

title: Glow-Touched
intro_lines: Tide-Puck's fur pulses with each heartbeat.
Insects swarm its light; the pup snaps them from the air.
Shadows stretch wrong — fleeing the hum, not the light.

choices.label: Use the pup as a lure

outcomes.text: Crabs and fish flock to the hum. You net a haul while Tide-Puck basks in the feast.
Something large circles the light. A reef shark beaches itself snapping at the pup. You drive it off.
The hum draws a UTC patrol's night glasses. They log the anomaly. Your camp is marked.
Fresh water dulls the light. Tide-Puck shivers, coat returning to normal. The night feels safer.
The water hisses on its fur — steam rising. The shard's essence resists. The pup whimpers, light flaring brighter.
Darkness returns. Tide-Puck sleeps. You breathe easier. The sailcloth smells of ozone after.
The tarp dissolves where it touches the pup. Threads unravel into humming dust. The light spreads.

history_note: Tromelin castaways kept one fire alive for 15 years using wreck timber and the island's single shrub, knowing relighting was near impossible in damp conditions.

title: The Shard's Choice
intro_lines: The shard on your workbench hums.
Three paths lie open: grind it, sell it, or wake it.
Tide-Puck growls at the sound — a low, wet rattle.

outcomes.text: Powder hums like crushed stars. Your sails catch night winds; crew morale soars.
Dust infiltrates your lungs. You cough blood that glitters. The pigment works, but at a cost.
The mortar shatters. Shard fragments embed in your hands. They do not come out.
The factor pays well — gold and a quiet promise. Your camp gains supplies; UTC gains a weapon.
The factor's escort recognizes you. They take the shard, your gold, and leave you bound for the warship.
The pool erupts in light. A Tideborn scout surfaces, bows, and leaves a pearl. The shard is gone.
The water boils. Something vast brushes the pool's floor. The shard sinks deeper. You hear laughter.
Nothing. The shard sits inert. Tide-Puck laps the water, indifferent. A waste.

history_note: Pirate articles under Bartholomew Roberts mandated equal shares of fresh food and liquor, with defrauding the company punished by marooning — choices carried weight.

title: The Light That Wouldn't Die
intro_lines: Dawn breaks but Tide-Puck still hums — brighter now.
The light paints your shelter walls in impossible colours.
A UTC cutter appears on the horizon, glass trained on you.

outcomes.text: You vanish into the canopy. The cutter's boats find only an empty camp and warm coals.
The hum betrays you. Marines track the light through foliage. A volley cracks overhead.
A warning shot across their bow. They hesitate, then withdraw — logging the encounter.
They return fire. Your cover splinters. Tide-Puck's light makes you a beacon.
Your shot hits their powder store. The cutter burns. No witnesses. But the hum remains.
The officer takes Tide-Puck. They sail. Your camp is safe. The silence is worse than cannon fire.
The officer laughs. "We want the source, not the dog." They shell the beach. You run.

history_note: Pedro Serrano's smoke signals were ignored by passing ships fearful of shoals; castaways could not rely on rescue and had to choose concealment or confrontation.

title: Shard-Fingers
intro_lines: Your fingertips end in crystalline points, numb and cold.
Wood warms where you touch it; stone sings.
Tide-Puck refuses to let you pet it.

outcomes.text: The totem drinks rain and hums. Fresh water collects in its bowl — pure, sweet, endless.
The wood bleeds sap that hardens into shards. Your fingers lengthen. The totem watches.
Flames sear the crystals to slag. Pain blanks your mind. Fingers heal — human again. The gift is gone.
Fire feeds the shards. They grow up your arms. You become a beacon. Tide-Puck howls.
A scout finds you. Her touch dissolves the crystals into seawater. You owe a debt.
They study you instead. "A successful binding." You are taken to their ruins.
No one comes. The crystals reach your wrists. You carve runes into your shelter walls to remember.

history_note: Ada Blackjack taught herself to shoot, trap, and build a stove from kerosene cans while nursing a dying man — castaways improvise tools and skills from wreckage.

title: The Factor's Return
intro_lines: The UTC cutter returns.
No flag.
No warning shot. "The shard woke something.

outcomes.text: A binding crystal has fractured. The Sovereign stirs. UTC offers gold, powder, and a truce to help rebind it.
It's a trap. Marines rise from the surf. The factor draws a hidden pistol.
A Tideborn arrow takes the factor mid-sentence. The cutter flees. You have a body and a message.
One shot. The cutter retreats. UTC marks you for death. Free pirates cheer the news.
The factor wears armour under the coat. Your shot fails. His men swarm the beach.
"The ruins know more than I do." The factor leaves. A scout watches from the cliffs. The truce holds — for now.
The factor finds the arches. He returns with a relic and a grin. "Thank you." UTC power grows.

history_note: Pirate havens operated on a chain of victuallers, receivers, and bribed protectors; dealing with corporate powers like UTC mirrored historical pirate dealings with colonial authorities.

title: The Pool Remembers
intro_lines: The tide-pool where you sank the shard now hums at low
Fish swim in perfect spirals.
Crabs march in lines.

choices.label: Listen with your hands in the water

outcomes.text: Visions: the Sovereign's spine is a mountain range. The binding crystals are nails. One is loose.
The water freezes your hands. Numbness climbs. You pull back, but the cold stays in your bones.
Something bites. Not a fish. You yank back a finger missing to the knuckle. The pool laughs.
The hum dies. The voice screams — a sound that cracks your eardrums. Silence returns.
The poison clouds. The water turns red. A tentacle lashes out, dragging you in. Tide-Puck bites it.
Your palm across the surface. The pool drinks. The voice whispers coordinates. A UTC cache. A Tideborn vault.
The pool takes more than offered. Your arm goes numb to the shoulder. The voice demands more.

history_note: Pedro Serrano flipped sea turtles onto their backs and drank their blood when no rain came; castaways used every bodily resource for survival.

title: Puck's Trail
intro_lines: Weeks after the cutter took Tide-Puck, a track appears.
Glowing paw prints in the mud, leading inland.
They pulse — a heartbeat you feel in your chest.

outcomes.text: A UTC camp. Tide-Puck in a cage of dark crystal — draining its light to power a binding array.
The prints end at a cliff. Tide-Puck's collar lies there, cut. No body. The rain washes the hum away.
Free pirates ambush you. "The dog's worth gold to UTC." They want your map to the camp.
Flames eat the prints. The pulse in your chest stops. You mourn. The camp sleeps safer tonight.
Fire flares green. The prints burn into the soil — permanent, humming. UTC will find them. So will others.
Next dawn: a single humming scale on your doorstep. Tide-Puck lives. It knows you wait.
The fish rots. No scale. The prints fade. Whatever watched decides you're not worth the effort.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk hid from Spanish ships knowing they would enslave him, waiting years for an English vessel — castaways weigh concealment against the hope of rescue.

title: Beacon of the Deep
intro_lines: Lightning strikes your shelter — and grounds in your arms.
The crystals drink the bolt.
You are the lightning rod. So does the Sovereign.

outcomes.text: The leviathan rises. The cutter fleet breaks. UTC burns. You ride the wave back to shore, changed.
The Sovereign ignores your intent. It takes everything — UTC, Tideborn, your camp. You survive. Barely.
The crystals shatter. The beacon dies. The Sovereign screams — a sound that stops hearts. You wake days later.
Scouts swarm the beach. They bind your arms with kelp-rope. "The beacon serves." You are taken.
A Tideborn elder arrives. She severs the crystals with a song. You are free. The light remains in your eyes.
You walk into the surf. The ocean drinks the lightning. The crystals go dark. You are human again. Cold. Whole.
The sea rejects you. A riptide spits you back. The crystals flare. The Sovereign knows now.

history_note: Tromelin castaways built 1.5m thick coral walls with backs to the trade wind after a storm destroyed their shelters; survival required adapting structures to environmental threats.

title: The Binding Array
intro_lines: The UTC array hums with stolen light.
Tide-Puck is the battery.
Dark crystals pulse around the cavern.

outcomes.text: Iron meets dark crystal. The array explodes. Tide-Puck is flung free — you catch it. The Sovereign roars, unbound.
The backlash hurls you against the wall. Tide-Puck takes the blast. Its fur goes dark. It does not move.
UTC guards swarm. You fight free but the array holds. Tide-Puck screams as they drag you out.
Your shard seals the crack. The array stabilizes. The UTC officer salutes. Tide-Puck's light steadies — contained.
The shard feeds the crack. Dark crystal spreads up your arm. The officer orders you chained — "volunteer."
You snatch the pup. The array wails. UTC gives chase. You reach the jungle. The binding weakens behind you.
A dark crystal spikes through your leg. You fall. Tide-Puck bites the crystal — shatters it. The array breaks.

history_note: Careening crews grounded ships at high tide, heeled them over to scrape teredo worms and weed, defenceless while guns were landed in beach batteries — vulnerability created opportunity.

title: The Spine of the World
intro_lines: At lowest tide, the water pulls back — far back.
A ridge of bone and coral breaches the surface
Three nails of dark crystal protrude. One is loose.

outcomes.text: Iron bites bone. The Sovereign shudders — asleep again. The tide rushes back. UTC camps celebrate. Tideborn weep.
The bone bleeds black ichor. It burns your hands. The nail goes in, but the Sovereign wakes. One eye opens.
Your hammer shatters. The nail flies loose. The ridge sinks. The tide returns with a wall of water.
The nail sings as it leaves the bone. The Sovereign breathes — a wave of pure force. You ride it. Free.
The rope snaps. The nail drops back. The Sovereign thrashes — tsunami scours the island. Your camp is gone.
A Tideborn elder catches the nail. "Fool." She drives it back in. You are bound, gagged, left on the reef.
You press your shard-touched fingers to the crystal. Memories flood: the Sovereign is the islands. The binding is the tide.
The resonance shatters your mind. You babble coordinates, depths, names of dead Tideborn. Your crew binds you.
A UTC sniper takes the shot. You fall. The nail glints in your dead hand. The tide covers all.

history_note: Pedro Serrano and a second castaway quarrelled then reconciled on Serrana Bank; isolated survivors' choices affect not only themselves but the fragile social order they create.
